correctness.rationale: Re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify_lambda1.py unchanged: ALL VERIFY_OK (S1-S5). (a) S1: sympy exact trace identity tr(M)-2 = s(100s-91)/4 with both residuals 0 (sin^2(2w) rule proved); independently re-verified numerically at lam=0.3, 0.806, 1.0, 1.194 (agreement to ~1e-9) via 2x2 monodromy. Hence tr(M)=2 iff s=0 (lam in 2Z, excluded) or s=91/100; s(lam)=sin^2(pi lam/2) strictly increasing on (0,1) gives unique root lam1=(2/pi)arcsin(sqrt(91)/10)~0.8060266320; symmetry s(2-lam)=s(lam) gives lam2=2-lam1~1.194; scan confirms no other roots below 2. S4 independent 8x8 interface-determinant min-SV ~3.6e-17 at lam1, ~4.4e-17 at lam2 vs 6.3e-2 control at lam=1 confirms. (b) No-decay lemma proof checked line-by-line: case phi0 in [pi/2,2pi] gives max 1; case phi0 in [0,pi/2] gives max(sin phi0,cos phi0)>=1/sqrt2; 721-direction scan witnesses 0.707107. Correct, so no nonzero linear-phase CGO decays on the 270-degree cone. (c) Explicitly conditional (IF A(f0)!=0); draft states no certified lower bound A(f0=x1)!=0 is proved and claims only conditional structural obstruction, not unconditional falsity. Quadrature sign-flip table and formal c_R=-1.064 mismatch are labeled supporting motivation only, not proof. No overclaim; boundary conditions (lam>0, trivial 2Z roots excluded, fixed 4:1 quadrant geometry) handled.

No prior source states or implies s=91/100, lam1=(2/pi)arcsin(sqrt(91)/10), or max>=1/sqrt2 on this cone; recomputation from the general method still requires the new monodromy evaluation done here.
